Commercial Transparency

Campaign Fees & Production Scope Breakdown

At NOXAS, we maintain absolute commercial transparency. To ensure clean accounting and alignment with your marketing budget, our client proposals clearly itemize:

  • Agency Management & Creative Direction: Covers creator discovery, negotiation, contract preparation, briefing, and review.
  • Creator Compensation (Talent Fees): Paid directly or passed transparently to creators based on their tier, reach, and agreed deliverables.
  • Content Usage Rights & Paid Whitelisting: Licensing rights for running creator content as paid ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube) are negotiated and itemized separately based on duration (e.g. 30, 90, or 365 days).
  • Advertising Media Spend & Shipping: Paid media spend budgets and product seeding samples are handled separately based on your target marketing budget.
